annotations.text: An 8-way multiplexer composed from two 4-way multiplexers and one final selector.
A two-level selection tree; SEL 0 chooses inside each pair and SEL 1 chooses the pair.
SEL=0 routes A; SEL=1 routes B.
NOT is NAND with the same signal connected to both inputs.
The primitive used as the construction starting point for the Nand2Tetris hardware track.
OR follows from De Morgan: NOT(NOT A NAND NOT B).
